units.characteristics: the melting heart of terror; the pomp of the arrogant laid low
units.gist: the day of the LORD against Babylon: 'all hands will be feeble, and every human HEART WILL MELT... their faces aflame'; 'I will put an end to the POMP of the arrogant, and lay low the pompous PRIDE of the ruthless' - dread dissolving the interior; arrogance levelled

units.characteristics: self-deifying pride ('I will make myself like the Most High') and its fall to Sheol
units.gist: THE GEM - the taunt over the fallen oppressor: 'YOU SAID IN YOUR HEART, I will ASCEND to heaven, above the stars of God I will set my throne on high... I will make myself LIKE THE MOST HIGH'; 'but you are brought down to SHEOL, to the far reaches of the pit' - the archetype of self-exalting pride and its inevitable fall

units.characteristics: God's unannullable purpose vs human plans; Zion as the refuge of the afflicted
units.gist: 'as I have PURPOSED, so shall it stand... who will annul it?'; the hand stretched out over all nations; and to Philistia's false rejoicing, the answer: 'the LORD has founded Zion, and in her the AFFLICTED of his people find REFUGE' - the fixed counsel of God; refuge for the lowly

units.characteristics: Moab's pride; the prophet's grief for the judged (moaning inner parts)
units.gist: 'we have heard of the PRIDE of Moab - how proud he is! - his arrogance, his insolence, his idle boasting'; yet 'my INNER PARTS MOAN like a lyre for Moab, my inmost self for Kir-hareseth'; the throne 'established in STEADFAST LOVE... one who seeks justice' - pride judged, held with the prophet's genuine grief for the doomed

units.characteristics: looking to the Maker vs the work of one's hands; forgetting the Rock of refuge
units.gist: GEM - 'in that day man will LOOK TO HIS MAKER, and his eyes will look on the Holy One... he will NOT look to the altars, the work of his hands'; 'you have FORGOTTEN the God of your salvation and have not remembered the ROCK of your refuge' - the gaze turned from self-made idols to the Maker; the forgotten Rock

units.characteristics: God's calm restraint; the quiet watching from his dwelling
units.gist: 'thus the LORD said: I will QUIETLY LOOK from my dwelling like clear heat in sunshine, like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest' - God's unhurried, watchful stillness over the nations' turmoil (calm sovereignty, not agitation)

units.characteristics: the emptied spirit turning to false counsel; self-vaunted wisdom made folly
units.gist: 'the heart of the Egyptians will MELT... the SPIRIT of the Egyptians within them will be EMPTIED OUT, and I will confound their counsel; they will inquire of the idols and the mediums'; the 'wisest counselors give stupid counsel'; 'a spirit of CONFUSION' - the interior drained and disoriented, its boasted wisdom turned to folly

units.characteristics: striking and healing; the enemy brought to know and return to the LORD
units.gist: 'the LORD will strike Egypt, STRIKING AND HEALING, and they will RETURN to the LORD, and he will listen to their pleas and heal them'; 'the Egyptians will KNOW the LORD'; 'Blessed be Egypt my people' - even the enemy's interior turned, judgment become healing, the outsider made God's own

units.characteristics: misplaced hope shamed; the boast that cannot deliver
units.gist: Isaiah walks naked and barefoot as a sign; 'they shall be DISMAYED AND ASHAMED because of Cush THEIR HOPE and of Egypt THEIR BOAST'; 'this is what has happened to those in whom we HOPED... how shall we escape?' - hope and boast placed in the wrong refuge, exposed as unable to save

units.characteristics: the prophet's anguish at the vision; the watchman's night-long post
units.gist: GEM - 'my HEART STAGGERS; horror has appalled me; the twilight I longed for turned into TREMBLING' (the seer undone by what he sees); the watchman motif - 'upon a watchtower I stand continually by day, stationed whole nights'; 'Watchman, WHAT TIME OF THE NIGHT?... Morning comes, and also the night' - the burdened seer; the waiting watch through the dark

units.characteristics: trusting the defences not the Maker; fatalistic hedonism refusing to mourn
units.gist: THE GEM - they fortify the city, collect the waters, 'BUT YOU DID NOT LOOK TO HIM WHO DID IT, or see him who planned it long ago'; the LORD called for 'weeping and mourning', 'and behold, JOY AND GLADNESS... Let us EAT AND DRINK, FOR TOMORROW WE DIE' - trust in one's own works not God; the refusal to mourn, hedonism in the face of death

units.characteristics: self-monumentalising pride; the peg that gives way
units.gist: Shebna 'who cut out HERE A TOMB FOR YOURSELF... a dwelling in the rock' - the official building his own monument; hurled away 'like a ball'; replaced by Eliakim, 'a peg in a secure place... a throne of honour' - yet even that peg 'will give way and fall' - self-securing pride displaced; no human security final

units.characteristics: the pride of glory defiled; commerce made holy to the LORD
units.gist: Tyre the merchant-city, 'bestower of crowns, whose merchants were princes'; 'the LORD has purposed it, to DEFILE THE POMPOUS PRIDE of all glory, to dishonour all the honoured of the earth'; yet at the last 'her merchandise will be HOLY TO THE LORD' - self-glorying wealth humbled, then consecrated
